title: ID0402255-DC/Si-D/FR - [DXQ0ui] Surge protection device fault
description:
Reported behavior/issue:
The charger is unavailable.
After rebooting online or on site, the situation does not improve.
When the charger is open, no visual information seems abnormal. The FC LEDs are correctly lit, do not flash...
I have not been able to repair the problem.
The connectors are "out of order" on the terminal screen.
And the two charging points are red.
Attached, a photo of the SCB error messages.
Root cause:
Solution:
On DAMEX Sanctioned List: No
Warranty Status:
Inactive (12/20/2024)
